The '''Execution Channel''' was a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] channel sponsored by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
Some observers listed it alongside "big rallies" and "purges" as a fun tool the Empire prefers to use to keep itself afloat.
